question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The company was engaged in __spurious__ trade practices.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fraudulent **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Spurious **means fake, false or not genuine. (नकली, झूठ या असली नहीं)

 
 
• **For example**: *The website was full of spurious claims that couldn't be verified.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Fraudulent **means deceitful or dishonest. (धोखेबाज या बेईमान)
 
 
• **For example**: *He was arrested for his fraudulent activities in the stock market.*
 
 
 
• So, the **synonym **for the underlined word is "Fraudulent" as it conveys the same meaning as "Spurious".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Effective **means producing the desired outcome or result. (वांछित परिणाम उत्पन्न करना)
 
• **Spacious **means having ample space or being roomy. (पर्याप्त जगह होना या विशाल होना)
 
• **Trendy **means fashionable or up-to-date. (फैशनेबल या अद्यतित)
